checks.name: frontend-build
command: node -e 'const f=require("fs"),a=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync("package.json")),b=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync("/opt/dependencies/package.json"));for(const k of ["dependencies","devDependencies","optionalDependencies","peerDependencies","overrides","workspaces","engines"])if(JSON.stringify(a[k])!==JSON.stringify(b[k]))process.exit(122)' && test "$(tr -d '\r' < package-lock.json | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$(cat /opt/node-lock.sha256)" || exit 122; cp -a /opt/dependencies/node_modules ./node_modules && npm run build

checks.name: frontend-lint
command: node -e 'const f=require("fs"),a=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync("package.json")),b=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync("/opt/dependencies/package.json"));for(const k of ["dependencies","devDependencies","optionalDependencies","peerDependencies","overrides","workspaces","engines"])if(JSON.stringify(a[k])!==JSON.stringify(b[k]))process.exit(122)' && test "$(tr -d '\r' < package-lock.json | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$(cat /opt/node-lock.sha256)" || exit 122; cp -a /opt/dependencies/node_modules ./node_modules && npm run lint

checks.name: screening-test
command: test "$(tr -d '\r' < requirements.txt | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$(cat /opt/python-lock.sha256)" || exit 122; python -m pytest -q
